title: Women's March Madness Beat The Men's. Once.
source: NCAA basketball championship game TV audience, Nielsen-measured, as reported by ESPN/CBS/Sportico/Front Office Sports/Sports Media Watch. Women's Final: 2021 Stanford-Arizona 4.1M, 2022 South Carolina-UConn 4.9M, 2023 LSU-Iowa 9.9M, 2024 South Carolina-Iowa 18.9M (Nielsen record for a women's college basketball broadcast), 2025 UConn-South Carolina 8.5M, 2026 South Carolina-UCLA 9.9M. Men's Final: 2021 Baylor-Gonzaga 16.9M (CBS), 2022 Kansas-North Carolina 18.1M (cable record at the time), 2023 UConn-San Diego State 14.7M, 2024 UConn-Purdue 14.8M (CBS/TBS/TNT), 2025 Florida-Houston 18.1M (CBS), 2026 Michigan-UConn 18.3M (TBS/TNT/truTV/HBO Max). 2024 was the first time in NCAA history the women's final out-rated the men's; every other year on record, the men's game led.
